articles.title: Five killed and 67 injured in Russian strike on shopping centre, Ukraine says
articles.description: The attack in Pavlohrad city centre was the third Russian strike on a mall within days, local media report.

articles.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
articles.description: One pilot told the other about the aircraft's "excessive speed" but received an uneven response even as alarms sounded.

articles.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
articles.description: The paper said it stood by its reporting, after publishing extracts from a book where the claim appears.

articles.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
articles.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

articles.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
articles.description: Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.
